primary_domains: PAC approximation and SOS formal verification
multi-platform internet research and source retrieval
selection_rules: Prefer official or high-reputation upstream sources.
Do not duplicate a skill already supplied by an enabled Codex plugin.
Reject generic skills that conflict with project-specific execution rules.
Keep one strong workflow per capability unless implementations are materially different.
